title: Dealer unable to identify or properly address issue
summary: Reviews focus on customers pushing dealers to identify an unresolved problem or provide a proper fix, with frustration when staff cannot clearly diagnose or demonstrate normal operation.

positive.summary: Positive feedback is limited to a customer still seeking answers while describing the issue as unresolved and abnormal.

negative.summary: Negative feedback centers on customers blaming the manufacturer or dealer response for failing to locate the fault and provide a proper fix or clear explanation.

limitations: The topic is based on only a few short fragments, so the specific underlying vehicle issue cannot be determined from the examples alone.
One positive example still describes an unresolved abnormal condition, so sentiment distinctions here may reflect overall review context more than fragment tone alone.
